infobox.effect: Provides 64 inventory slots while only taking up 9

sections.heading: Info
sections.text:
The Grenade case is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 64 inventory slots in a 8x8 grid and only takes up 9 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
- Grenades
- Grenade launcher cartridges
- UZRGM grenade fuze

sections.heading: Quest rewards
sections.text: - 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from Big Customer
